raw.name: Dark Eye

dictionary.lore: A crystal with the power of dark, one of the six elements that composes the world. Its dim glow has only been witnessed in the caves in the St. Lamia region of Grand Gaia. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates dark-enhancing tools.
